capture.note: Compiled after the session from the conversation record; not captured live.

prompt: [Author directive, condensed from Turkish] Revise LEM so that AI is auditable not only in data analysis but in cognitive writing: (1) ideation and theory building, (2) structuring and drafting, (3) mechanical editing. Section 1: extend 'invisible delegation' to ghost-thinking; add that 'we used ChatGPT' disclosures cannot tell whether the model fixed commas or built the thesis. Section 2: add conceptual ideation loops, argument synthesis workflows and semantic delta to P; add two-tier logging (substantive steps in full with override log; surface steps as meta-tags). Section 3: add P_ideation and P_drafting step-types. Section 6: make measurable whether social scientists use AI as idea generator or grammar assistant. Keep H/P/R intact; answer the call's 'AI slop' concern: the point is to prove editorial filtering of the model's cognitive input.
model_output: [Excerpt] Assessed as fitting and strengthening. Raised six issues: (1) cognitive steps cannot be validated by re-execution, so split P into executed vs traced steps; (2) author-kept logs are self-report, so capture them automatically with hash chaining; (3) the surface/substantive boundary must be enforced by a semantic-delta threshold with automatic escalation; (4) Section 4 needs evidence for the new capabilities; (5) Summary, risks and ethics need updates (stigma risk, redaction rule); (6) word limit.

override_log.proposal: Analytic steps executed, cognitive steps traced
Escalate surface edits above a semantic-delta threshold
Add evidence for cognitive steps to the planned studies
